subject: executor, store: Plumb the query max execution time to timebox the PD GetRegion grpc calls (#56923)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent: threads `max_execution_time` (ms) from `session` into `distsqlctx.DistSQLContext`/`kv.Request`, then uses it to apply context deadlines in point/batch get and coprocessor request paths to bound PD region-locate (GetRegion) RPC time. No remaining Blocker/High issues after checking later history on `upstream/master` (notable High-risk bo-context cancellation and max_execution_time usage inconsistencies were fixed later).
